name: jhon-ora-memorial-server
description: Memorial website backend for Jhon Sollano Ora

scripts.render-build: npm run build-client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const from=path.join(__dirname,'..','client','dist'), to=path.join(__dirname,'client_dist'); fs.rmSync(to,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync(from,to,{recursive:true}); console.log('client_dist built:',fs.readdirSync(to).length,'entries');"
